recipe_version.title: Grilled Mahi-Mahi with Mango-Jalapeño Salsa and Lime Rice
recipe_version.description: Chile-lime rubbed mahi-mahi fillets grilled until just flaky, topped with a juicy mango, red pepper, red onion, jalapeño, and cilantro salsa, and served over cilantro-lime jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: limes
ingredients.note: 2 juiced for salsa and rice, 1 zested for the fish, 1 in wedges

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tsp fish, 1/2 tsp salsa, 1/2 tsp rice

steps.title: Preheat, start the rice, and prep
steps.body: Turn the grill on to medium-high to preheat with the lid closed. Combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil, cover, cook on low 15 minutes, then rest covered; it cooks inside this prep and the grilling (overlap stated). Mix the chili powder, cumin, the zest of 1 lime, and 1 tsp salt and rub over the fish with 1 tbsp oil. Toss the mango, bell pepper, red onion, jalapeño, half the cilantro, the juice of 1 lime, and 1/2 tsp salt.

steps.title: Grill the fish
steps.body: Brush the hot grates with 1 tbsp oil. Grill the fillets 4 minutes, turn with a fish spatula, and grill 3 to 4 minutes more until opaque and flaking.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice with the juice of the second lime and the remaining cilantro. Serve the fish over the rice, topped with the salsa, with lime wedges.
